description: This file defines the class EachPromise in the GuzzleHttpomise namespace, which manages a collection of promises, providing functionality to iterate over multiple promises with configurable concurrency, handling fulfillment and rejection callbacks, and managing promise resolution states.

classes.name: EachPromise
classes.description: Represents a promise that iterates over many promises and invokes side-effect functions during processing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an EachPromise with an iterable of promises or values and configuration options such as concurrency and fulfillment/rejection callbacks.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns the aggregate promise that represents the completion of all managed promises.

methods.name: createPromise
methods.description: Initializes the internal aggregate promise and sets up its resolution and rejection behavior.

methods.name: refillPending
methods.description: Fills the list of pending promises up to the concurrency limit.

methods.name: addPending
methods.description: Adds a new promise to the pending list based on the current position in the iterable.

methods.name: advanceIterator
methods.description: Advances the internal iterator safely, with mutex locking to prevent generator errors.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Handles the completion of a promise at a given index, removing it from pending and refilling if necessary.

methods.name: checkIfFinished
methods.description: Checks if the iteration and pending promises are complete, resolving the aggregate promise if so.
